next.reason: 1985 READ GR14: 'The END-READ phrase delimits the scope of the READ statement.' §2023:14.9.30.2 keeps '[ END-READ ]' in the READ formats, and §2023:14.5.3.2 makes an explicit scope terminator end 'the most-recently preceding unterminated statement having the statement-name' and any unterminated statements between. Same programs, same scope.
